classification.difficultyReason: Multiply unequal colour probabilities for three independent cubes and use a complement for at least one red face.

content.prompt: Cube A has 5 red faces and 1 white face, cube B has 3 red faces and 3 white faces and cube C has 2 red faces and 4 white faces. The 3 cubes are tossed. What is the probability of:

answer.worked:
The cube tosses are independent.
$$\begin{align*}P(\text{3 red})&=\frac56\times\frac36\times\frac26\\P(\text{3 red})&=\frac{5}{36}\end{align*}$$

The cube tosses are independent.
$$\begin{align*}P(\text{3 white})&=\frac16\times\frac36\times\frac46\\P(\text{3 white})&=\frac{1}{18}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: red with A and B and white with C?

answer.worked:
Multiplying the independent probabilities gives:
$$\begin{align*}P(R_A\cap R_B\cap W_C)&=\frac56\times\frac36\times\frac46\\P(R_A\cap R_B\cap W_C)&=\frac{5}{18}\end{align*}$$

children.prompt: red with A and white with B and C?

answer.worked:
Multiplying the independent probabilities gives:
$$\begin{align*}P(R_A\cap W_B\cap W_C)&=\frac56\times\frac36\times\frac46\\P(R_A\cap W_B\cap W_C)&=\frac{5}{18}\end{align*}$$

answer.short:
$\frac{17}{18}$

Use the complement of all three faces being white.
answer.worked:
The complement of at least one red face is three white faces.
$$\begin{align*}P(\text{at least 1 red})&=1-P(\text{3 white})\\P(\text{at least 1 red})&=1-\frac16\times\frac36\times\frac46\\P(\text{at least 1 red})&=\frac{17}{18}\end{align*}$$
